claim: .claude/settings.local.json is not tracked in the repository at the base commit and .gitignore ignores it, so local machine settings are no longer part of the committed tree.

evidence.quote: .claude/.credentials.json .claude/settings.local.json .claude/_state/
Do not add secrets or local machine state.
.claude/settings.local.json removed from git index

rationale: The export holds only Plans/ and scripts/, so the files this closure really rests on (.gitignore, the git index, AGENTS.md) cannot be anchored. I checked them read-only against the base commit instead, with no edit and no checkout: `git -C /mnt/Cursor/PuppetMaster ls-tree -r --name-only be4766513ff71776346fc73b84f2542990f955af` lists no settings.local.json anywhere (only .claude/CLAUDE.md, .claude/agents/..., ...), and `git show be4766513f:.gitignore` has '.claude/settings.local.json' at line 19, next to .claude/.credentials.json and .claude/_state/. The repair is present at base. The anchored dependency is only the immutable audit-001 repair_report.json, which records the change ('.claude/settings.local.json removed from git index', '.gitignore'). A later re-tracking of the file would not change that hash, so the lead should note that this closure's true dependency (.gitignore line plus the untracked state) sits outside the anchor scheme. Round 2 (fix): This round uses the full base checkout at be4766513f (git checkout with .gitignore and AGENTS.md), which supersedes the export limitation stated above. Two of the three pieces are now anchored: '.gitignore#section=Local/runtime agent state' is the comment-headed block '# Local/runtime agent state' (the anchor tool reads a '# ' comment line as a heading, so the block runs to '# Build outputs') and holds the '.claude/settings.local.json' ignore entry; 'AGENTS.md#section=Safety' holds 'Do not add secrets or local machine state.' The third piece cannot be anchored by any anchor kind: the fact that the path is untracked at base is a property of the git tree, not of file content, and an untracked absent file cannot be a ref. Checked read-only instead: in the base checkout, git ls-files lists no settings.local.json, the file does not exist, and git check-ignore -v reports '.gitignore:19:.claude/settings.local.json'. The immutable repair_report.json stays as the record of the index removal. The lead should know the .gitignore anchor depends on the comment text '# Local/runtime agent state' staying unique; if it changes, the anchor stops resolving and the row comes up for review.

One wording drift: the closure reason says UCC-106 also exposes these fields, but the text later narrowed (DL-153 era) to make UCC-106 an explicit lineage exclusion. Its 11 cmd.onboarding.* tokens are lineage only, its 8 packet candidates are rejected, and its 14 ui.onboarding.* typed local actions use the closed pm.product_onboarding.action_request.v2/action_result.v2 contracts owned by Planning_Wizard PWIZ-021..025. The overlay instead keeps 'the catalog as the command-ID SSOT while avoiding duplicated payload tables': it gives one common envelope ('`payload_required`: `dispatch_id`, `command_id`, `source_surface`, `actor_ref`, and the row-specific identity listed below') and, per row range, a list of mostly optional keys. rationale: cmd_validate_auto_decisions groups rows by decision_id and fails a duplicate id with no historical identities ('duplicate_decision_id'). It fails any row whose inputs_hash is not listed for that id ('non_grandfathered_duplicate_decision_identity') and any repeat of a listed identity ('duplicate_grandfathered_decision_identity'), against a literal table of 19 historical ids. upsert_auto_decision raises SystemExit when more than one row matches the decision_id, telling the caller to 'choose a new unique future decision_id instead of mutating grandfathered history', and also refuses to change scope/decision of a single match. The schema description and the Release_Supply_Chain addendum state the same policy. A read-only check of Plans/auto_decisions.jsonl at base (224 rows) finds the same 19 duplicate ids and no row outside the grandfathered (decision_id, inputs_hash) set, so no new duplicate has crept in since the repair.
